Question
========
What did the Kuznets curve originally propose?

Answerlist
----------
* Inequality first rises with industrialisation and later falls as economies mature
* Inequality falls steadily with growth from the start
* Inequality rises forever with growth
* Growth and inequality are unrelated

Solution
========
Kuznets (1955) proposed an inverted U. Later research found no automatic turning point; where inequality fell, policies, wars, and crises played a central role.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
